newsitem.title: USA: RailAmerica sells $7.5 mln of common stock.
newsitem.headline: RailAmerica sells $7.5 mln of common stock.

text.p: RailAmerica Inc on Monday said it completed the sale of 1.67 million of restricted common shares at $4.50 a share in a private placement.
The shares were sold to certain accredited investors and raised $7.5 million for the company, RailAmerica said. It did not identify the investors.
The company said it would use proceeds for acquisitions of rail lines, as well as for capital expenditures and other purposes.
Restricted shares are those directly purchased from a company and may only be sold after a specified holding period expires.
